# P0-02 — frontend lane (domain visualizer unification)

Branch `build/w0-p002-fe` (from `4b68d9b`). Scope: `src/**`, `e2e/visualizer-domain.spec.ts`, this file.

## What changed

- **One frame type per concept.** `src/components/visualizer/panels/types.ts` holds the canonical structured
  frame types for all 8 domains (router-branch shape + agent-only extras: gravity/statmech frames,
  `particle_obs`, `model_domain`, Slater flow matrix, ⟨σᶻσᶻ⟩ matrix, scalar LNV indicator). `src/types/manifest.ts`
  now only re-exports them (it used to redefine the router-branch versions).
- **One normaliser.** `src/lib/visualizer/domainFrames.ts` lifts either wire shape (router structured / agent flat,
  including the bundled `public/fixtures/visualizations/*.json`) into those types. Unknown quantities stay
  `null`/empty; nothing is inferred (see decisions below). It also owns the viz stream envelope unwrapping and the
  REST/WS/SSE path rules.
- **One fixture loader.** `services/manifest.ts` talks to the `cosmic_forge_viz` API only (normalising responses);
  its offline stand-in manifest now claims `frame_count: 0` (was an invented 60). Bundled fixtures are loaded by the
  new `getDomainVisualization` in `services/qcompass/visualizer.ts` through the shared `loadFixture`, labelled
  `metadata.synthetic = true`; a missing fixture or one for another domain gives an empty timeline.
- **Shared panel frame.** `panels/PanelShell.tsx` (title, empty state, caption, tooltip style, colour helper) — one
  shape for all panels.
- **Route fold.** `src/routes/visualizer.$domain.$id.tsx` + `.lazy.tsx` deleted; their loader/surface now live in
  `src/routes/domains/$domain/visualizer.$id.tsx`. Non-cosmology domains render `DomainVisualizerSurface`
  (synthetic-fixture banner, frame scrubber, per-domain layout). `FEATURES.liveDomainStream` on → frames from
  `openDomainStream` (backend-sourced runs only, never fixtures) replace the fetched timeline as they arrive.
  Cosmology keeps main's existing view at this URL; the full cosmology surface stays at `/visualizer/$runId`.
- **Route defects fixed on the way** (they made the route unreachable):
  1. `domains/$domain/visualizer.tsx` was the layout parent of `visualizer.$id.tsx` with no `<Outlet/>` — run pages
     rendered the run list. Renamed to `visualizer.index.tsx` (route id `/domains/$domain/visualizer/`).
  2. Both loaders returned the domain plugin object (contains functions) → SSR dehydration failed
     (`Seroval Error`) → client invariant "Expected to find a dehydrated data". Loaders now return
     `{domainId, label}`; components resolve the plugin. (Same pattern remains in `runs.tsx`, `runs.$id.tsx`,
     `configurator.tsx`, `research.tsx` — not in this lane's directive; flagged for the integrator.)
  3. Cosmology registered only when `domain-selector` happened to load first → intermittent 404 for
     `/domains/cosmology.ucglef1/...`. `lib/domains/register-all.ts` now imports `./cosmology.ucglef1` too.
- **Stream client on the P0-02 viz protocol** (coordinator note; `docs/build/lanes/P0-02-viz.md` in the viz lane):
  WS messages are binary envelopes `{type, seq, tau, payload}` (msgpack, or JSON bytes when the first byte is `{`)
  in the order `header` → `frame`×N → `end`; `error` also ends the stream; the `"__done__"` text sentinel is no
  longer handled. Messages are decoded in arrival order (promise chain). SSE: the `header` event's data (no `tau`)
  is skipped; `done` ends. gravity/statmech use the M8 routes `/api|ws/qcompass/domains/{gravity.syk|statmech.sampling}/…`
  (no SSE for them → WS). A top-level `synthetic: true` in the GET response is surfaced as the synthetic banner.
- `features.ts`: only the `liveDomainStream` doc comment (route path updated).

## Per-panel decisions (12 conflicting panels + condmat pairs)

| Panel | Router branch | Agent branch | Unified |
|---|---|---|---|
| OrbitalOccupation3D | R3F spheres, colour by orbital energy | SVG bars + count caption | R3F spheres; colour by energy only when every orbital has one, else neutral; agent caption |
| EnergyConvergence | recharts line | SVG polyline + ΔE caption | recharts + ΔE caption |
| SlaterSankey | determinant weight bars (recharts) | orbital→orbital flow chords | both: bars when determinants given, chords when flow matrix given; formatter typed via inferred recharts `Formatter` + `isWeightRow` guard (was `(v: number, …)` — TS error) |
| HamiltonianOverlay | term list + KaTeX, active highlight | τ/phase, active-term chips, provenance_ref | term list + context strip; chips when no term list; provenance in caption |
| SpectralHeatmap | rect grid with axes | SVG grid + size caption | router grid; caption shows k/ω ranges, or "index axes" when source had none |
| ChiralCondensateTrace | recharts over timeline | SVG + range caption | recharts + range caption + current-τ reference line; props `frames`, `currentTau` |
| StringBreakingAnim | readout, bar, break badge | σ(τ) trace + τ marker | readout/bar/badge + trace when timeline given; bar scaled by trace peak (router fixed 0.5 scale only without timeline) |
| LNVTracker | ΔL/ΔB/rate readout + ΔL(τ) chart | per-frame 0/1 indicator strip | structured tracker when present, else indicator strip |
| ShellOccupation | labelled bars, colour by `energy < -4` | SVG bars + caption | labelled bars; energy gradient colour only when all energies known (magic −4 MeV threshold dropped); formatter typed (was TS error); caption |
| GaugePlaquettes | z-projected cell grid by flux | bars of action density S_p | cell grid; shades by flux when every plaquette has it, else action density; caption names the quantity |
| AtomArray3D | R3F, Rydberg colour | SVG + blockade-radius circles | R3F + translucent blockade-radius spheres; Rydberg colour only when known |
| BlockadeCorrelations | g² pair scatter | ⟨σᶻᵢσᶻⱼ⟩ matrix heatmap | both, side by side when both present; the two observables are never converted into each other |
| LatticeBonds vs LatticeWithBondColors | — | i,i+1 pairing of bare strengths | **kept LatticeWithBondColors**, deleted LatticeBonds: bonds drawn only with known endpoints; strengths without endpoints counted in caption (the i,i+1 pairing is not supported by the data) |
| OtocButterfly vs OtocButterflyCone | heatmap | heatmap + caption | **kept OtocButterflyCone** (+ caption, `|C|` shading, index-axes note), deleted OtocButterfly |

Agent-only panels: `ModelDomainBadge` (nuclear) → adapter over main's `@/components/ModelDomainBadge` plus the
caveat text; `ProvenanceWarningBanner` (gravity) → adapter over main's `@/components/ProvenanceWarningBanner`
and the **R18 guard**: if any frame is a learned Hamiltonian the banner is shown, and if no warning text exists
the gravity panels are not rendered (`data-testid="gravity-provenance-blocked"`). `ParticleObservablesTable`,
`SpectralFormFactor`, `EstimatorTrace` kept (prop type `| null`), placed in layouts.

| Domain | Layout | Panels | Bundled timeline |
|---|---|---|---|
| chemistry.molecular | chemistry-layout | OrbitalOccupation3D, EnergyConvergence, SlaterSankey, HamiltonianOverlay | h2-sto3g, lih-631g |
| condmat.lattice | condmat-layout | LatticeWithBondColors, OtocButterflyCone, SpectralHeatmap | hubbard-4x4 |
| hep.lattice | hep-layout | GaugePlaquettes, ChiralCondensateTrace, StringBreakingAnim, ParticleObservablesTable | schwinger-1plus1d, zN-toy |
| nuclear.structure | nuclear-layout | ModelDomainBadge, ShellOccupation, LNVTracker | 0nbb-1plus1d-toy |
| amo.rydberg | amo-layout | AtomArray3D, BlockadeCorrelations | rydberg-mis |
| gravity.syk | gravity-layout (new) | ProvenanceWarningBanner guard, SpectralFormFactor | none bundled → empty state offline; backend via `/api/qcompass` |
| statmech.sampling | statmech-layout (new) | EstimatorTrace | none bundled → empty state offline; backend via `/api/qcompass` |
| cosmology.ucglef1 | main's existing view (unchanged) | full surface at `/visualizer/$runId` | — |

Note: main's run ids for nuclear/hep (`ovbb-1plus1d`, `zN-lattice`) do not match the bundled viz fixture ids;
the fixtures are reachable by URL id. Gravity/statmech viz fixtures would live in `public/` (outside this lane).

## Ledger-style entries

- **LF1 — test fix, `src/lib/__tests__/manifest.test.ts`.** The `vi.mock` factory referenced top-level
  `apiFetchMock`/`BackendUnavailable`, which `vi.mock` hoisting evaluates before they exist (file failed to load).
  They are now created with `vi.hoisted(...)`. No assertion changed (old = new, all four tests).
- **LF2 — test retarget, `e2e/visualizer-domain.spec.ts`.** Old: `page.goto("/visualizer/chemistry/test")` expects
  title `/chemistry\/test — Visualizer/`; `/visualizer/cosmology/ucgle-f1-demo` shows link "Open cosmology
  visualizer"; `/visualizer/phantom/x` → 404. New: the folded route — per-domain panel titles + synthetic label for
  the 5 domains with bundled timelines (title `/<id> viz — QCompass/`, no uncaught exceptions); empty state for an
  unknown run; cosmology keeps its existing view; `/domains/phantom/visualizer/x` → 404; old
  `/visualizer/chemistry/test` → 404. The cosmology link assertion moved with the route: the cosmology layout (and
  its link) is still in `DomainVisualizerSurface`, but the folded route keeps main's cosmology view instead.
- **LF3 — removals.** `routes/visualizer.$domain.$id.tsx`, `.lazy.tsx` → replaced by
  `routes/domains/$domain/visualizer.$id.tsx`. `panels/condmat/LatticeBonds.tsx` → `LatticeWithBondColors.tsx`.
  `panels/condmat/OtocButterfly.tsx` → `OtocButterflyCone.tsx`. `routes/domains/$domain/visualizer.tsx` →
  renamed `visualizer.index.tsx` (same content, serialisable loader).
- **LF4 — no invented values.** `getManifest` offline stand-in `frame_count` 60 → 0. ShellOccupation's hard-coded
  `energy < -4` colour threshold removed. Flat ⟨σᶻσᶻ⟩ matrices are not relabelled as g²; bare bond strengths are
  not paired with sites.
- **LF5 — stream protocol** (see above): `"__done__"` sentinel handling removed, replaced by the envelope `end`/`error`.
- Not changed (noted for later tickets): `services/qcompass/visualizer.ts#getVisualization` still synthesises an
  8-frame `progress` timeline when a run fixture has no embedded timeline (main behaviour, used by the cosmology
  card) — an R7 concern for P4-03/P4-04. `lib/domains/types.ts` keeps a separate generic `VisualizationFrame`/
  `VisualizationTimeline` (domain-agnostic `{tau, data}` envelope, a different concept from the panel frames).
